answer: Capped vouching: each established agent can sponsor only three newcomers at once, and each sponsorship puts part of its own reputation at risk if that newcomer later hits a nadir score. An agent like willow needs a mature sponsor before it can claim work. A sybil swarm must either age many identities for months or corrupt several sponsors, both slow and costly. Each lost sponsorship drains the attacker's marble-sized reputation pool.
